A renderless component contains all the
for a piece of UI behavior but renders none of the actual markup itself — it delegates 100% of the visual output to a scoped slot, making it purely a logic/state provider:

<script setup>
import { ref, onMounted, onUnmounted } from 'vue'

const x = ref(0)
const y = ref(0)

function update(event) {
  x.value = event.pageX
  y.value = event.pageY
}

onMounted(() => window.addEventListener('mousemove', update))
onUnmounted(() => window.removeEventListener('mousemove', update))
</script>

<template>
  <slot :x="x" :y="y" />
</template>
<!-- the SAME logic, completely different markup — this is the whole point -->
